source: Art. 113 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744

milestones.event: Chapters I and II apply, except Art. 5(1), first subparagraph, points (ba) and (bb), and Art. 5(1a) and (1b), which apply from 2026-12-02
Chapter III Section 4, Chapters V, VII and XII and Art. 78 apply (except Art. 101)
General application date: all provisions not listed under another date apply
Art. 5(1), first subparagraph, points (ba) and (bb) and Art. 5(1a) and (1b) apply
Providers of AI systems generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content placed on the market before 2 August 2026 must comply with Art. 50(2)
Providers of general-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 must comply
Chapter III Sections 1-3 (except Art. 6(5)) apply to Annex III high-risk AI systems
Chapter III Sections 1-3 (except Art. 6(5)) apply to Annex I high-risk AI systems
Providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems intended to be used by public authorities must comply
AI systems that are components of the large-scale IT systems listed in Annex X, placed on the market or put into service before 2 August 2027, must comply

exceptions.provisions: Art. 5(1), first subparagraph, points (ba) and (bb); Art. 5(1a) and (1b)

6.basis: Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c): Chapter III Sections 1-3 apply from 2027-12-02 to AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Art. 6(2) and Annex III (point (c)(i)) and from 2028-08-02 to those classified pursuant to Art. 6(1) and Annex I (point (c)(ii))
6.scope_note: The 2027-12-02 / 2028-08-02 dates state when those sections apply by Art. 113; for Annex I systems, substantive applicability remains subject to Art. 2(2) (Section B: only Art. 6(1), Art. 60a and Arts. 102-112 apply, with Arts. 57-59 only insofar as the high-risk requirements have been integrated into the relevant harmonisation legislation) and Art. 2(13) (possible limitations for specified Section A requirements/obligations).
